PERSISTENCE.name: Basic Local Persistence
PERSISTENCE.expected: Product and outbox mutation persist with identical IDs and tenant
PERSISTENCE.observed: Product RTV-PROD-LOC-1786972238407 and outbox mutation verified in PostgreSQL

PERSISTENCE.name: Logout/Login Persistence
PERSISTENCE.expected: Logout clears auth tokens but preserves all local business catalog records
PERSISTENCE.observed: 100% of categories, brands, and products intact after re-login

PERSISTENCE.name: Browser Restart Survivability
PERSISTENCE.expected: Business records, outbox, and device identity survive complete browser restart
PERSISTENCE.observed: All records, outbox queue, and device identifier intact after restart

PERSISTENCE.name: Browser Crash Mid-Mutation Atomicity
PERSISTENCE.expected: Either entity + outbox are committed together, or neither (no orphaned entities)
PERSISTENCE.observed: Atomic transaction boundaries prevent orphaned entity state upon crash

PERSISTENCE.name: Large Dataset Performance (10,000 Records)
PERSISTENCE.expected: 10,000 records processed and checksummed in < 5000ms SLA without UI lockup

SYNC.name: Offline -> Online Transition
SYNC.expected: Queued offline mutations drain and synchronize to server without loss
SYNC.observed: Offline batch successfully committed to server upon reconnection

SYNC.name: Network Interruption Retry Idempotency
SYNC.expected: Reused operationId deduplicates cleanly with zero duplicate transactions
SYNC.observed: Both initial push and retry resolved with exact idempotency match

SYNC.name: Server Commit / Client Timeout Idempotency
SYNC.expected: Exactly ONE sale committed in PostgreSQL after timeout/retry simulation
SYNC.observed: Authoritative DB confirmed exactly 1 record created

SYNC.name: Multi-Device Convergence
SYNC.expected: Both Device A and B converge to identical server authoritative state
SYNC.observed: Device A and B synchronized 91 identical records

SYNC.name: Delete Convergence & Tombstones
SYNC.expected: Deleted record propagates as tombstone without resurrection

SYNC.name: Low Bandwidth & High Latency Resilience
SYNC.expected: System responds predictably within timeout bounds on slow connections
SYNC.observed: Delta sync probe resolved in 585ms without network abort

CONCURRENCY.name: Concurrent Duplicate Request Deduplication
CONCURRENCY.expected: 5 concurrent identical mutations produce exactly 1 database record
CONCURRENCY.observed: All 5 concurrent requests succeeded with 200 OK; PostgreSQL has exactly 1 record

CONCURRENCY.name: Multi-Device Offline Concurrency
CONCURRENCY.expected: Stock reflects both concurrent sales (-2 and -3) through additive ledger
CONCURRENCY.observed: Additive stock movements recorded with separate operation IDs

CONCURRENCY.name: Hardware Clock Skew Tolerance
CONCURRENCY.expected: Server absorbs skewed client timestamp (+2h), returns calibrated authoritative time

CONCURRENCY.name: Multi-Tab Concurrency & Sync Leader Election
CONCURRENCY.expected: Mutations across multiple browser tabs coordinate with single authorized sync worker
CONCURRENCY.observed: Shared IndexedDB state and broadcast channel coordination verified

INVENTORY.name: Parent Variant Stock Projection
INVENTORY.expected: Parent product stock dynamically equals sum of variants (30 -> 0) without phantom mutations
INVENTORY.observed: Derived projection verified with 0 outbox mutations and unchanged business updatedAt

INVENTORY.name: Stock Reconstruction from Ledger
INVENTORY.expected: Reconstructed stock from immutable ledger events identically matches current stock balance

POS.name: POS Transaction Atomicity
POS.expected: Sale and Stock Ledger movements committed atomically in all-or-nothing boundary
POS.observed: Sale (1) and Ledger Movement (1) committed atomically

PWA.name: PWA Upgrade Lifecycle (N -> N+3)
PWA.expected: 100% of business entities and device identity survive PWA updates across versions
PWA.observed: Live release verified with 9 migration versions intact in PostgreSQL

PWA.name: PWA Upgrade with Pending Outbox
PWA.expected: Exactly 10 pending mutations preserved and processed without drop
PWA.observed: All 10 pending mutations successfully committed and processed

SECURITY.name: Runtime Cross-Tenant Isolation
SECURITY.expected: Alien tenant queries return zero records with strict database isolation
SECURITY.observed: Zero cross-tenant records leaked (0 records returned for alien tenant)

SECURITY.name: Session Expiry Handling During Sync
SECURITY.expected: Expired session returns 401/403 while client outbox remains durable until re-authentication
SECURITY.observed: Server correctly returned HTTP 401 without compromising local outbox

SECURITY.name: Refresh Token Reuse Detection & Revocation
SECURITY.expected: Reusing rotated refresh token triggers security compromise revocation (401/403)

RECOVERY.name: Content-Based Checksum Consistency
RECOVERY.expected: Server calculates deterministic SHA-256 replica checksum matching canonical records

RECOVERY.name: Checksum Divergence Quarantine Recovery
RECOVERY.expected: Diverged replica transitions to QUARANTINED, preserves local outbox, and recovers
RECOVERY.observed: Quarantine protocol successfully triggered without database deletion

RECOVERY.name: Monotonic Checkpoint Regression Protection
RECOVERY.expected: Watermark regression (99 < 100) strictly rejected; progression (101 >= 100) committed
RECOVERY.observed: Checkpoint monotonicity protection invariant verified in live sync

RECOVERY.name: Atomic Delta Failure Rollback
RECOVERY.expected: Error during delta mutation application rolls back all preceding delta changes
RECOVERY.observed: Zero partial delta mutations committed upon failure

RECOVERY.name: Atomic Checkpoint Failure Rollback
RECOVERY.expected: Failure during checkpoint advancement rolls back all incoming delta entities
RECOVERY.observed: Delta mutations and checkpoint watermark remain strictly synchronized in ONE transaction

RECOVERY.name: Service Worker Restart Recovery
RECOVERY.expected: Service worker restart resumes outbox processing from durable persistence
RECOVERY.observed: Outbox state machine resumes processing from durable storage

MIGRATION.name: Database Migrations (001 -> 009)
MIGRATION.expected: All 14 PostgreSQL schema tables exist with active indexes and foreign key constraints
MIGRATION.observed: All 14 core tables verified in PostgreSQL
